Definition: an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain
BiblicalUsage: Moreh is the early rain, the teacher — God gives the former rain moderately and the latter rain in the first month, and the psalmist says the rain fills the pools for pilgrims passing through the valley of Baca. The same word elsewhere names a teacher, and an archer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rain and the teacher are one picture: God sends both in season, and both make the dry ground live.
